heating_substations_page.module1_text:
The primary purpose of the inlet and metering module is precise commercial accounting of thermal energy consumed. It is equipped with differential pressure controllers to maintain required pressure levels in the return heating network.

The module includes shut-off valves (ball valves on each line), dirt separators/strainers, and instrumentation (thermometers, pressure gauges). It features flow meters, heat calculators, control units, and certified temperature/pressure transmitters.
heating_substations_page.module2_text:
Primary purpose is supplying consumers with domestic hot water while maintaining stable output temperature during fluctuating consumption peaks.

Consists of plate heat exchangers, shut-off valves, 2-way control valves regulating heating medium flow, circulation pumps, and monitoring instrumentation.
heating_substations_page.module3_text: When ventilation circuits need heat integration, an additional plate heat exchanger is configured as a dedicated make-up/ventilation module with associated monitoring instrumentation.
heating_substations_page.module4_text: Connects building heating circuits to district networks. Flow parameters are regulated via motor-driven control valves. Outdoor air temperature sensors enable weather-compensated heating control, delivering substantial energy savings.
heating_substations_page.module5_text: Maintains target operational pressure by absorbing volumetric water expansion due to temperature variations in closed-circuit heating systems.
